policy: A candidate enters production only after two dual runs, semantic/resource parity, and a thin adapter.

adopted.adapter: internal/formats/zip and lib/formats/zip retain path, CRC, collision, budget, and truncation policy
adopted.evidence: isolated cross-codec probe passes 6/6 on Native and 6/6 on Wasm, plus the product ZIP regression suite; no parser semantic layer was replaced
adopted.promotion_gate: two release-candidate dual runs with trusted performance/resource evidence

adopted.scope: portable Shift_JIS/JIS X 0208 decoding; CP932 extensions remain Native-only
adopted.adapter: internal/readers/source_io/cp932_portable.mbt rejects replacement output and maps decoded text to UTF-8
adopted.evidence: run_encoding.mbtx covers 名前, ASCII, half-width katakana, JIS X 0208, split-character streaming, truncated/malformed rejection, and explicit FA40 CP932-extension rejection on both targets; product adapter adds the same fail-closed boundary
adopted.remaining_gate: two Native/Wasm dual runs against a complete CP932 corpus; Native iconv extension mapping is tested separately
adopted.promotion_gate: full portable CP932 corpus and release-candidate resource/performance evidence

rejected_or_deferred.reason: upstream event model does not carry this project's document nodes, XML source spans, entity policy, and fail-closed diagnostics without a semantic reimplementation
DOM recovery is useful, but direct HTML-to-output integration would bypass local assets, ARIA/table semantics, provenance, and resource budgets
value-tree API lacks the source range and duplicate-key diagnostics required by the current TOML contract
Python-generated entity tables add a source-build dependency and the AST adapter would need to recreate local frontmatter, source map, and asset semantics
HTML output loses Office source refs, cached values, notes, assets, and accurate-mode policy
reader model does not expose the existing merged-cell, cached-value, attachment, and provenance contract
native-only build paths and observed PDF text normalization differences prevent a shared linear-Wasm replacement
